name: VPN Egress Check
description: Steady-state VPN health for one device: read the in-app connection status, then verify the REAL exit country with a device-side geo-IP check (the app UI can't reveal a wrong-country connection). If egress drifted, reconnect to the preferred location and re-verify; a still-wrong exit — or a device on an unsupported/over-ceiling app version — fails the run loud so the notification bus alerts, and screenshot-on-failure captures evidence. The final screenshot is the success evidence. Target it across the fleet with an FQL query; each device resolves its own version adapter.
